On this episode of Health, Happiness, and Healing with Hippocrates, hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement interview Hansi about her transformation from a fast-food diet and chronic skin and digestive issues to healing through colon cleansing, wheatgrass, sprouts, and a raw plant-based lifestyle.

Hansi shares how these changes cleared her skin, resolved reproductive problems, helped her become a natural bodybuilder, and ultimately led to a surprise pregnancy; learn more about Hippocrates Health Institute at 561-471-8876 or HippocratesHealthInstitute.org.
